tagline: A hand picked assortment of salame from our meat case!
description:

If the meat case is this person's favorite section of the store, this gift is for them!

name: Leporati Prosciutto di Parma, 24 month
tagline: handcut paper thin with care when you order it!
description: The Leporati family has been making prosciutto for more than 3 generations. The quality of their products is evident - only the most carefully raised and selected hogs are used to make their reserve prosciutto. Cured with just enough salt, this prosciutto is left to age in drying rooms on traditional wooden frames for at least 24 months. Bold, buttery, aromatic and a bit more concentrated than its 16 month counterpart. Trimmed and sliced paper thin with care when you order it. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Pio Tosini Prosciutto di Parma
description: The roots of the Pio Tosini company run deep and date back to the beginning of the last century (1905) in the heart of northern Italy, where Ferrante Tosini (Pio Tosini’s father) started his business slaughtering pigs and curing his own cuts of pork meat in the back room of the family’s grocery store. Today, Pio Tosini is still a family company, where Pio’s son-in-law and nephew carry on their family’s century old tradition and passion. Because they use less salt in the curing process, their hams must be of the highest quality and age for a longer time (up to 20 months) to achieve their signature sweetness. The result of this passion and experience is a Prosciutto di Parma that is unsurpassed in flavor, texture and quality. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Fermin Jamon Iberico de Bellota
tagline: The Top of the Cured meat mountain - one of the world's great delicacies
description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. Still family owned and operated in the medieval mountain town of La Alberca, they were also the first to bring authentic Spanish Iberico and Serrano ham to the US. Along with caviar, foie-gras and truffles, Iberico de Bellota ham is truly one of the world's great delicacies. This famous ham is produced from 100% Iberico pigs, all of which enjoy a free-range, happy life during the "Montanera" season (acorn season). During the last 3-4 months of their lives, they will eat as many as they want until they almost double their weight. During this period, each pig can eat between 6 and 10 kilos of acorns and between 3 and 4 kilos of natural pastures. The tiny, magnificent "bellota" (acorns) add a pungent buttery flavor, delicate texture, intense color and aroma that separates Iberico de Bellota from all pretenders. When you wake up in the morning and feel like you deserve something really special (you do), this is it.

name: Fermin Jamon Iberico, Grain Fed
description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. Still family owned and operated in the medieval mountain town of La Alberca, they were also the first to bring authentic Spanish Iberico and Serrano ham to the US. Along with caviar, foie-gras and truffles, Iberico ham is truly one of the world's great delicacies. The Pata Negra, or black hoof, is made only from black Iberian hogs. Cured for up to 4 years, and prized for its exceptionally smooth texture and rich taste, the flavor of true Jamon Iberico is simply amazing. To fully appreciate it's quality, we recommend enjoying it on its own with little more than a good piece of bread and a glass of wine. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Galloni Prosciutto di Parma
tagline: The workhorse prosciutto you've been looking for...
description: This is your workhorse Parma. Wrapping and grilling shrimp or pork tenderloin? Using it in a pasta recipe? This is your go-to. If there was an index for quality & price, Galloni scores in the upper right corner. Fine enough for your charcuterie platter, economical enough to use in the kitchen!

name: Fermin Jamon Serrano
description: Fermin has been curing the finest quality pork products in the world since 1956. Still family owned and operated in the medieval mountain town of La Alberca, they were also the first to bring authentic Spanish Iberico and Serrano ham to the US. The quality of their Jamon Serrano is unsurpassed. The hams are cured for almost two years in drying rooms with open screened windows, exposing them to the mountain air and the change of seasons. The result is a delicious, well marbled, full flavored Serrano with balanced salinity. It is delicate, sweet and nutty. Perfect enjoyed with young manchego, quince paste, marcona almonds and a glass of Rioja. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Incontro New York Strip Bresaola
tagline: Yes...this is slow cured NY Strip!
description: Founded by Nebraska-based Tony Incontro in 2018, Incontro Cured is firmly committed to preserving and sharing the most authentic and age-old products mother nature allows. Their Piedmontese NY Strip Bresaola is a bit of a departure, but not really. Yes, it's USDA certified beef, but it's made with the same attention to detail and tradition that define all Incontro Cured products. The flavor & texture of this highest quality cured beef is just incredible. Tender & delicate, it is instant beef carpaccio. Lay it out on plate and lace it with your best olive oil and an optional squeeze of lemon.

name: Bayonne Ham
tagline: Authentic cured ham from the Pays-Basque region in France
description: One of the legendary hams of Europe, Jambon de Bayonne has been made in southwest France and sold at the port of Bayonne for generations. Made in adherence to strict PGI rules, true Bayonne ham can only be made with pigs born and bred in and around the Aquitaine, Midi-Pyrenees, and Poitou-Charentes regions. Aged for at least 12 months, this ham is tender and sweet, with a nuanced nutty flavor and a melt-in-your-mouth texture. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Brooklyn Cured Bresaola
tagline: Cured beef tenderloin seasoned with porcini mushrooms & black pepper
description: This dry-cured beef round is elegant and lean, but unlike traditional bresaola, it is dusted with porcini mushrooms and black pepper, giving it an earthen, deep flavor. Sliced thin, it is perfect topped with fresh arugula, shaved Parmigiano-Reggiano, and finished with extra virgin olive oil. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Levoni Speck
tagline: Artisan smoked Italian prosciutto, speck, sliced
description: Speck is a delicately smoked, air-cured ham from South Tyrol, Italy's northernmost province. It is made from the pig's rear thigh, boned and seasoned with salt, pepper, juniper and a touch of sugar. Fantastic when enjoyed with hearty bread, a northern Italian cow's milk cheese, some fruit and a white wine from the Alto Adige. Use Speck the same way you would Prosciutto di Parma when you feel like a touch of smoke - pizza, pasta, antipasti or panini. Size & shape of the slices will vary, but they will always taste great!

name: Tempesta Duck Prosciutto
description: Tempesta Artisan Salumi is the culmination of more than 100 years of family expertise and is rooted in the rich Calabrian legacy of making unapologetically authentic and inspired products. By embracing local relationships, exceptional quality, and an uncompromising focus on artisanal craft, the Fiasche family commitment endures in producing a full range of traditional Italian salumi of the highest standard. Their Duck Prosciutto is made by curing Moulard duck breast with Fabbri amarena cherries, warming spices, and coriander. An excellent non-pork charcuterie option, the flavor is rich and buttery, with the classic, savory flavor of duck fat. Try it paired with Fabbri cherries, on a salad, or as a snack on its own. Each slice is small, but rich and flavorful, so a little bit goes a long way. If you’re looking for something new and fun on your next charcuterie board, this is a fantastic choice!
